title: Elephant with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='sparkle' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe97a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='24' fill='#8fb6d9'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='26' ry='19' fill='#a9cbe8'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='26' y='78' width='10' height='17' rx='4' fill='#7fa6cc'/>
  <rect x='40' y='80' width='10' height='16' rx='4' fill='#8fb6d9'/>
  <rect x='54' y='80' width='10' height='16' rx='4' fill='#8fb6d9'/>
  <rect x='66' y='78' width='10' height='17' rx='4' fill='#7fa6cc'/>
  <!-- toenails -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='93' r='2' fill='#e8f3fb'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='94' r='2' fill='#e8f3fb'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='94' r='2' fill='#e8f3fb'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='93' r='2' fill='#e8f3fb'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='#a9cbe8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='17' fill='#bcdaef'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='36' rx='11' ry='15' fill='#8fb6d9'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='36' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#f0a8c0'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='36' rx='11' ry='15' fill='#8fb6d9'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='36' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#f0a8c0'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='6' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='6' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='5' fill='url(#sparkle)'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='5' fill='url(#sparkle)'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='32' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='32' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='36.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='36.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle star tips -->
  <polygon points='42,27 43,31 47,32 43,33 42,37 41,33 37,32 41,31' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <polygon points='58,27 59,31 63,32 59,33 58,37 57,33 53,32 57,31' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='43' r='3' fill='#f0a8c0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='43' r='3' fill='#f0a8c0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- trunk -->
  <path d='M47 44 Q44 56 50 64 Q56 70 60 62' fill='none' stroke='#a9cbe8' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M47 44 Q44 56 50 64 Q56 70 60 62' fill='none' stroke='#bcdaef' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- trunk tip -->
  <circle cx='59' cy='62' r='4' fill='#8fb6d9'/>
  <!-- tusk -->
  <path d='M45 47 Q42 54 45 58' fill='none' stroke='#fff6d8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
